Apistogramma eunotus is a dwarf cichlid from the Río Ucayali in Peru and the Solimões/Amazon in Colombia and Brazil, as far east as the Japurá.
Described from the Río Ucayali close to the city of Pucallpa, central Peru but is widely-distributed in tributaries of that system, as well as the Solimões/Amazon as far east as the Japurá drainage.
